siblings.summary: Picks for sleeping within a few minutes' walk of Sven Wassmer Memories, from the on-property Quellenhof to budget self-check-in rooms in the village.

sources.title: Sven Wassmer Memories — Grand Resort Bad Ragaz
sources.claim: Memories sits inside Grand Resort Bad Ragaz; chef Sven Wassmer; alpine cuisine.

sources.title: MICHELIN Guide — Sven Wassmer Memories
sources.claim: Memories holds three MICHELIN stars in Bad Ragaz.

sources.title: Boutique Hotel Ochsen — Bad Ragaz
sources.claim: Boutique Hotel Ochsen is in central Bad Ragaz at Bartholoméplatz 4 with 17 rooms blending vintage and modern, an in-house winery, art gallery and Mediterranean-creative restaurant.

sources.title: Hotel Bellevue — Heidiland
sources.claim: Hotel Bellevue Bad Ragaz is a small boutique in a grand old house, cosy with nooks and stylish accessories.

sources.title: Hotel Bellevue — Tripadvisor
sources.claim: Guests highlight Bellevue's unique bohemian atmosphere, friendly service and that it is not overpriced for its quality.

sources.title: Hotel Schloss Ragaz
sources.claim: Hotel Schloss Ragaz is a castle built around 1890 by Conrad Sonderegger (a Swiss Panama Canal engineer) as a summer residence at Schloss-Strasse 1, with antique-furnished rooms, garden pavilions and glamping lodges.

sources.title: Park Hotel Sonnenhof — Relais & Châteaux
sources.claim: Park Hotel Sonnenhof Vaduz has been a Relais & Châteaux member since 1979, 29 rooms across diverse themes, four-star superior, with award-winning gourmet restaurant Marée and panoramic park grounds.

sources.title: Park Hotel Sonnenhof — official
sources.claim: Park Hotel Sonnenhof Vaduz is at Mareestrasse 29 above town, with spa and pool, and Marée restaurant in the Eagle's Nest run by Hubertus Real.

sources.title: Hotel Weiss Kreuz — Malans
sources.claim: Hotel Weiss Kreuz in Malans has just four double rooms at Dorfplatz 1, CHF 220 weekday / CHF 260 weekend, with breakfast and Nespresso machine in each room.

sources.title: Weiss Kreuz — GaultMillau
sources.claim: GaultMillau highlights Weiss Kreuz as a renovated village-square hotel-restaurant in a Bündner wine village with both architectural and culinary impact.

sources.title: Schlaf-Fass Maienfeld
sources.claim: Schlaf-Fass Maienfeld is a converted 8,000-litre wine barrel sleeping up to 4 guests on the Hermann family farm at the foot of Falknis above Maienfeld, with WC and sink 40 m away in an annex.

sources.title: Schlaf-Fass — MySwitzerland
sources.claim: The Schlaf-Fass is steps from Heidi Village, Heidi Fountain and the Heidi Alp.

sources.title: Berghotel Gaffia — Pizol
sources.claim: Berghotel Gaffia at Pizol is at 1,750 m above sea level with 9 cozy double and family rooms and a mountain-hut feel.

sources.title: Bad Ragaz → Vaduz — Rome2Rio
sources.claim: Bad Ragaz to Vaduz is 19.3 km, about 13 minutes driving.

sources.title: Pizol — skiresort.info
sources.claim: Bad Ragaz lies about 4 km from the Pizol ski resort, roughly 5 minutes by car or post-bus.

sources.title: Bad Ragaz → Malans — Rome2Rio
sources.claim: Bad Ragaz to Malans is about 13 km; the bus takes 26 minutes.

sources.title: Marée at Park Hotel Sonnenhof — alpen-erleben
sources.claim: Marée at Park Hotel Sonnenhof is Hubertus Real's Michelin-starred panorama restaurant; Marée holds 16 Gault Millau points.
